features.title: Build your grotto
features.description: Browse 50 original detailed cave walls, floors, pools, curves, treasure and trap pieces by category.

features.title: Full-detail printing
features.description: Lighter coloured meshes keep the editor responsive. Print packs use the full-resolution STL geometry, including separate door and pit-cover inserts.

features.title: Your offline workshop
features.description: The starter scenery downloads through the launcher and stays on your computer. Existing scenes and worlds remain unchanged.
